in_sanskrit.name: Chinni
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Beloved, Dear
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Chinni एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Tamil word 'chinna' meaning 'little', 'young', or 'beloved'. In Hindu mythology, Chinnamasta is a goddess with five heads, representing the five kosas (sheaths) of the self. Chinni can also be a term of endearment for a beloved child.

in_hindi.name: चिन्नी
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Chinni is derived from the Hindi word 'chhota' which means small or young. It is often used as a term of endearment for young children or infants.

in_tamil.name: சின்னி
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Chinni is derived from the Tamil word 'சின்ன' which means small or young. It is a common name for young girls in Tamil Nadu.

in_telugu.name: చిన్ని
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Chinni is derived from the Telugu word 'చిన్న' which means small or young. It is a popular name for young girls in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.

in_marathi.name: Chinni
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chinni हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Tamil word 'chinna' meaning 'little', 'young', or 'beloved'. In Hindu mythology, Chinnamasta is a goddess with five heads, representing the five kosas (sheaths) of the self. Chinni can also be a term of endearment for a beloved child.
